violation_type.title: Administrative and clerical duties that take the caregiver's attention away from the children (26 TAC §744.1203(3)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Administrative and clerical duties that take the caregiver's attention away from the children
violation_type.typical_finding: There were no caregivers present when the children were dismissed from school and arrived to the program.  Eleven children were in the cafeteria for approximately 4 minutes before a caregiver arrived.

finding_variants.text: There were no caregivers present when the children were dismissed from school and arrived to the program.  Eleven children were in the cafeteria for approximately 4 minutes before a caregiver arrived.
Based on information gathered during the investigation, one caregiver was completing incident reports, while the other two caregivers were cleaning during the time the child was last seen.
Through investigation, it was determined that a caregiver involved with other work duties was not able to supervise a child sufficiently to prevent an injury.
